dedupe_keys.name: a railway network dataset incorporating multi type train operation records and train scheduling

description: A Railway Network Dataset Incorporating Multi-Type Train Operation Records and Train Scheduling is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Jianqing Wu, xukai xiao (University of Wollongong). Train operation data can be used in research, but datasets released by railway companies are often unstandardized or incomplete, limiting their direct applicability. Publicly available railway network datasets thatcomprehensively integrate train operation records with scheduling information remain rare. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 413637624 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
